artifacts.preview_review_notes: Reviewed in pt-maker's isolated headless browser, not HyperFrames Studio: every scene of the presenter HTML captured at its resolved pose, 53 mid-build frames across all scenes, and t=0 / build start / mid-build / resolved for chart scenes 4, 8 and 10. The 5 HyperFrames check snapshots of the linear film match the presenter. Live playback at normal and 0.25x speed was not watched by a person.

checklist_notes.image_identity_continuity: No image sequences. One photo (scene 3). The SVG roadster uses the same path data in every scene.
checklist_notes.audio_media_rights_checked: No audio. The photo is CC BY-SA 4.0, credited on the slide and in assets/CREDITS.txt. GSAP is vendored under the GreenSock standard license. No Tesla logos, press photos or stream frames.
checklist_notes.full_timeline_previewed: Covered by captures at many time points plus the presenter QA traversal, not by watching it live.

narrative_claims.notes: The titles alone form a 기승전결 arc with one claim per scene; errata E1–E20 applied (E14 Nevera 검증, E17 Electrek for 2027~28, E18 production-slip count, E20 Plaid conditions), and every chip matches the ledger. The cover's '날았지만' leans on the hop qualifier given later in scene 6.

frame_design.notes: Consistent kicker, status rail and source line; varied layouts; charts drawn to scale; contrast 144/144 WCAG AA. Scene 10's measurement conditions now sit inside the green bars, so every row is one line. Scene 12 has an empty area top-left, and the ghost poses in scene 6 are thin.

motion_craft.notes: Six signature build families, each with a purpose (the car draws the delay line, stops halfway on range, rides the 0.81 s bar; the dial sweep; the fade to a dashed outline). prism/curtain/aperture all used, with neutral washes. Judged from pose captures, not watched live.

seam_continuity.notes: One right-facing SVG car and a left-to-right current, with the same family on reverse seams. The car's scale jumps between scenes (0.04–0.28 of frame width), and scenes 3 and 9 have no carrier (hard-resolve seams).

timing_readability.notes: Titles land before evidence (assertions pass). Builds end by 4–7 s, and dense scenes run 10–11 s in the 117 s film. Scenes 6 and 10 are still tight for film playback; in the live deck the presenter sets the pace.

accessibility_safe_content.notes: Unofficial / not-affiliated notice on the cover; every number has a text status chip (not colour only); photo credited on the slide and in CREDITS.txt; no audio dependence; reduced motion resolves to the final pose.

technical_determinism.notes: Static guard P0=0, lint 0, check --snapshots pass (runtime, layout, motion, contrast). Presenter QA passed twice (forward and reverse, jump, replay, keyboard, touch; max frame 16.8 ms). GSAP loads from the template's CDN (needs a network connection), and fonts are local() only.

remaining_p2: GSAP loads only from the CDN (template default), so the deck needs a network connection; offline it shows an error and does not start.
Fonts are local() only; long two-line titles (scenes 5, 6, 10) may rewrap on machines without Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo or Noto Sans KR.
The hero car's size jumps at seams 1→2 and 11→12; scenes 3 and 9 have no hero.
Scene 12: empty area top-left above the quote.
Scene 6: thin ghost poses in panel 1; scenes 6 and 10 are dense for linear film playback.
